title: The Secret Garden
description: A lonely young girl discovers a hidden garden in an old English manor. As she brings the garden back to life, she also transforms the lives of those around her.
setting: An old English manor and its secret garden

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: An orphaned boy discovers that he is a wizard and begins attending a magical school where he uncovers secrets about his past.
setting: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry

title: The Hobbit
description: A quiet hobbit joins a group of dwarves on a dangerous journey to reclaim their lost kingdom and treasure from a dragon.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
description: Two teenagers who meet at a cancer support group develop a deep relationship while navigating love, illness and life's uncertainties.

title: And Then There Were None
description: Ten strangers are invited to an isolated island, where they begin dying one by one according to a mysterious rhyme.
setting: An isolated island off the English coast
